-- Relational evaluation preserves input encounter order through every operator.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Binder (tree_any)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Map (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length, sum)

pub fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

pub fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif op == "aggref" then
    at(at(group, 0), e.index)
  elif op == "COUNT" then
    if length(e.args) == 0 then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      JInt(length(filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), column_of(e, group))))
  elif agg(op) then
    let vs = filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), column_of(e, group))
    if length(vs) == 0 then
      JNull
    elif op == "SUM" then
      JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
    else
      extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    first_present(e.args, row, group)
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "ISNULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "ISNOTNULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then
        JNull
      else
        JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then
          JBool(false)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(true)
      elif op == "OR" then
        if truth(a) || truth(b) then
          JBool(true)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(false)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn column_of(e : Expr, group : List(List(Json))) : List(Json) =
  map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group)

fn first_present(
  args : List(Expr),
  row : List(Json),
  group : List(List(Json))
) : Json =
  match args of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(a, rest) =>
      let v = evaluate(a, row, group)
      if is_null(v) then
        first_present(rest, row, group)
      else
        v

fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

pub fn fold_constants(e : Expr) : Expr =
  let n = Expr { ..e, args = map(fold_constants, e.args) }
  if (not(agg(n.op))
      && not(elem(n.op, ["lit", "col", "aggref"]))
      && all(\(a) -> a.op == "lit", n.args)) then
    Expr { ..literal(evaluate(n, [], [])), kind = n.kind }
  else
    simplify(n)

fn constant(b : Bool) : Expr = Expr { ..literal(JBool(b)), kind = "bool" }

fn same_column(a : Expr, b : Expr) : Bool =
  a.op == "col" && b.op == "col" && a.index == b.index

fn complementary(a : Expr, b : Expr) : Bool =
  b.op == "NOT" && length(b.args) == 1 && same_column(a, at(b.args, 0))
    || a.op == "NOT" && length(a.args) == 1 && same_column(b, at(a.args, 0))

-- Algebraic rewrites that hold only when the operand cannot be NULL. A
-- nullable column, or any column of an outer-joined source, blocks them:
-- `x = x` and `p OR NOT p` are UNKNOWN rather than TRUE on a NULL input.
fn simplify(n : Expr) : Expr =
  if length(n.args) == 1 then
    let a = at(n.args, 0)
    if elem(n.op, ["ISNULL", "ISNOTNULL"]) && not(a.nullable) then
      constant(n.op == "ISNOTNULL")
    else
      n
  elif length(n.args) == 2 then
    let a = at(n.args, 0)
    let b = at(n.args, 1)
    if same_column(a, b) && not(a.nullable) then
      if elem(n.op, ["=", "<=", ">="]) then
        constant(true)
      elif elem(n.op, ["<>", "<", ">"]) then
        constant(false)
      else
        n
    elif (elem(n.op, ["AND", "OR"])
        && complementary(a, b)
        && not(a.nullable)
        && not(b.nullable)) then
      constant(n.op == "OR")
    else
      n
  else
    n

pub fn conjuncts(e : Expr) : List(Expr) =
  if e.op == "AND" then
    append(conjuncts(at(e.args, 0)), conjuncts(at(e.args, 1)))
  else
    [e]

pub fn sources(e : Expr) : List(Int) =
  if e.op == "col" then
    [e.source]
  else
    flatten(map(sources, e.args))

fn combine(es : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  match es of
    Nil => literal(JBool(true))
    Cons(e, Nil) => e
    Cons(e, rest) => Expr { ..node("AND", [e, combine(rest)]), kind = "bool" }

-- Push a conjunct only when every referenced slot belongs to one input whose
-- rows can never be NULL-padded: the first source, or one reached by an inner
-- join. Filtering a source that a LEFT JOIN may pad would change which left
-- rows find a match, so such conjuncts stay above the join.
-- Slot numbers remain global; scan predicates receive a prefix padding.
pub fn optimize(plan : Plan) : Plan =
  let q = plan.query
  let terms = conjuncts(fold_constants(q.predicate))
  let padded = \(i) -> i > 0 && at(q.outer, i - 1)
  let pushable = \(e) -> let ss = sources(e) in length(plan.tables) > 1 && length(ss) > 0 && all(\(s) -> s == at(ss, 0), ss) && not(padded(at(ss, 0)))
  let fs = map(
      \(i) -> filter(\(e) -> pushable(e) && at(sources(e), 0) == i, terms),
      range(0, length(plan.tables)),
    )
  let rem = filter(\(e) -> not(pushable(e)), terms)
  let bq = Query {
    ..q,
    predicate = combine(rem),
    select = map(\(s) -> (fold_constants(fst(s)), snd(s)), q.select),
    joins = map(fold_constants, q.joins),
    having = fold_constants(q.having)
  }
  Plan { ..plan, query = bq, filters = fs }

fn join_rows(
  left : List(List(Json)),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  outer : Bool,
  width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(
      map(
          \(l) -> padded_matches(l, right, on, outer, width),
          left,
        ),
    )

-- ON FALSE and ON UNKNOWN both fail to match; an unmatched left row of an
-- outer join is emitted exactly once with every right column NULL.
fn padded_matches(
  l : List(Json),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  outer : Bool,
  width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  let matches = filter(
      \(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, r, [])),
      map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right),
    )
  if outer && length(matches) == 0 then
    [append(l, replicate(width, JNull))]
  else
    matches

pub type Group = Group { key: String, rows: List(List(Json)) }

fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) =>
      if g.key == key then
        Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest)
      else
        Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

fn groups_for(rows : List(List(Json)), keys : List(Expr)) : List(Group) =
  var gs := []
  for row in sof(rows) do
    let key = encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)))
    gs := add_group(gs, key, row)
  if length(keys) == 0 && length(rows) == 0 then
    [Group { key = "[]", rows = [] }]
  else
    gs

fn project(
  q : Query,
  row : List(Json),
  group : List(List(Json))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  if truth(evaluate(q.having, row, group)) then
    [map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, group), q.select)]
  else
    []

-- First occurrence wins; NULLs compare equal because the encoded form of a
-- projected row is its identity. The seen set is a map so that a wide view
-- result stays linearithmic rather than quadratic.
fn distinct_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  seen : Map(String, Bool)
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      let key = encode(JArr(r))
      if map_member(key, seen) then
        distinct_rows(rest, seen)
      else
        Cons(r, distinct_rows(rest, map_insert(key, true, seen)))

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc, nulls_first), rest) =>
      let x = at(a, i)
      let y = at(b, i)
      if is_null(x) && is_null(y) then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif is_null(x) then
        if nulls_first then
          -1
        else
          1
      elif is_null(y) then
        if nulls_first then
          1
        else
          -1
      else
        let c = compare_value(x, y)
        if c == 0 then
          row_compare(a, b, rest)
        elif desc then
          -c
        else
          c

-- A stable merge sort: ties keep encounter order because a left-hand row is
-- taken whenever the comparison is not strictly greater.
fn merge_rows(
  a : List(List(Json)),
  b : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match (a, b) of
    (Nil, _) => b
    (_, Nil) => a
    (Cons(x, xs), Cons(y, ys)) =>
      if row_compare(x, y, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(x, merge_rows(xs, b, order))
      else
        Cons(y, merge_rows(a, ys, order))

fn sort_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  let n = length(rows)
  if n <= 1 then
    rows
  else
    let half = n / 2
    merge_rows(
        sort_rows(take(half, rows), order),
        sort_rows(drop(half, rows), order),
        order,
      )

pub fn execute(plan : Plan) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  var scans := []
  var offset := 0
  for i in srange(0, length(plan.tables)) do
    let t = at(plan.tables, i)
    let padding = replicate(offset, JNull)
    let predicates = at(plan.filters, i)
    let rs = filter(
        \(r) -> all(\(p) -> truth(evaluate(p, append(padding, r), [])), predicates),
        t.rows,
      )
    scans := append(scans, [rs])
    offset += length(t.columns)
  var rows := at(scans, 0)
  for i in srange(0, length(q.joins)) do
    rows := join_rows(
        rows,
        at(scans, i + 1),
        at(q.joins, i),
        at(q.outer, i),
        length(at(plan.tables, i + 1).columns),
      )
  let filtered = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(q.predicate, r, [])), rows)
  let projected =
    if plan.aggregate then
      flatten(
          map(
              \(g) -> project(q, if length(g.rows) > 0 then at(g.rows, 0) else [], g.rows),
              groups_for(filtered, q.groups),
            ),
        )
    else
      flatten(map(\(r) -> project(q, r, []), filtered))
  finalize(plan, projected)

-- DISTINCT, then ORDER BY, then OFFSET/LIMIT, shared by one-shot queries and
-- by reads of an incrementally maintained view.
pub fn finalize(plan : Plan, projected : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  let distinct =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_rows(projected, map_empty)
    else
      projected
  let sorted =
    if length(plan.order) > 0 then
      sort_rows(distinct, plan.order)
    else
      distinct
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, sorted)
  let final =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      take(q.limit, skipped)
    else
      skipped
  JObj([
      ("columns", JArr(map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), q.select))),
      ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, final))),
    ])

-- Typed syntax and bound logical plan. JSON is used only for wire values.
import Json (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length)

pub effect Domain
  never reject(String) : Unit

pub fn demand(b : Bool, code : String) : Unit =
  if not(b) then
    reject(code)

pub fn arr(j : Json) : List(Json) =
  match j of
    JArr(xs) => xs
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      []

pub fn text(j : Json) : String =
  match j of
    JStr(s) => s
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      ""

pub fn integer(j : Json) : Int =
  match j of
    JInt(n) => n
    _ => 0

pub fn truth(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ => false

pub fn is_null(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JNull => true
    _ => false

pub fn is_false(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => not(b)
    _ => false

pub fn getfield(j : Json, key : String) : Json =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => lookup_field(xs, key)
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull

fn lookup_field(xs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match xs of
    Nil =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull
    Cons((k, v), rest) =>
      if k == key then
        v
      else
        lookup_field(rest, key)

pub fn fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Unit =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      demand(length(xs) == length(names), "INVALID_INPUT")
      demand(
          all(
              \(name) -> length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == name, xs)) == 1,
              names,
            ),
          "INVALID_INPUT",
        )
    _ => reject("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn reserved(s : String) : Bool =
  elem(
      to_upper(s),
      split(
          32,
          "SELECT DISTINCT AS FROM INNER JOIN LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC NULLS FIRST LAST LIMIT OFFSET AND OR NOT IS NULL TRUE FALSE COALESCE COUNT SUM MIN MAX",
        ),
    )

pub fn letter(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 97 && c <= 122 || c == 95

pub fn digit(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 48 && c <= 57

pub fn name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) > 0
    && letter(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(
        \(i) -> letter(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)),
        range(0, byte_len(s)),
      )
    && not(reserved(s))

pub fn value_type(v : Json) : String =
  match v of
    JInt(_) => "int"
    JBool(_) => "bool"
    JStr(_) => "text"
    JNull => "null"
    _ => "invalid"

pub type Column = Column {
  name: String,
  kind: String,
  nullable: Bool,
  qualifier: String,
  source: Int,
  index: Int
}

pub type Table = Table {
  name: String,
  columns: List(Column),
  rows: List(List(Json))
}

pub type Expr = Expr {
  op: String,
  value: Json,
  qualifier: String,
  name: String,
  args: List(Expr),
  kind: String,
  nullable: Bool,
  index: Int,
  source: Int
}

pub fn node(op : String, args : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  Expr {
    op = op,
    value = JNull,
    qualifier = "",
    name = "",
    args = args,
    kind = "",
    nullable = true,
    index = -1,
    source = -1
  }

pub fn literal(v : Json) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("lit", []), value = v, kind = value_type(v), nullable = is_null(v) }

pub fn column_ref(q : String, n : String) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("col", []), qualifier = q, name = n }

pub fn agg(op : String) : Bool = elem(op, ["COUNT", "SUM", "MIN", "MAX"])

-- An untyped NULL literal takes on whatever type its context requires.
pub fn compatible(a : String, b : String) : Bool =
  a == "null" || b == "null" || a == b

pub fn at(xs : List(a), i : Int) : a =
  match nth(i, xs) of
    Some(x) => x
    None => at(xs, i)

pub type Query = Query {
  select: List((Expr, String)),
  sources: List((String, String)),
  joins: List(Expr),
  outer: List(Bool),
  predicate: Expr,
  groups: List(Expr),
  having: Expr,
  has_having: Bool,
  order: List((String, Bool, Int)),
  distinct: Bool,
  limit: Int,
  offset: Int
}

pub type Plan = Plan {
  query: Query,
  tables: List(Table),
  filters: List(List(Expr)),
  aggregate: Bool,
  order: List((Int, Bool, Bool))
}

pub fn validate_table(j : Json) : Table =
  fields(j, ["name", "columns", "rows"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  demand(name_ok(n), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let cs = map(validate_column, arr(getfield(j, "columns")))
  demand(length(cs) > 0, "INVALID_INPUT")
  demand(unique(map(\(c) -> c.name, cs)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let rows = map(arr, arr(getfield(j, "rows")))
  for row in sof(rows) do
    demand(length(row) == length(cs), "INVALID_INPUT")
    for i in srange(0, length(cs)) do
      demand(cell_ok(at(row, i), at(cs, i)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  Table { name = n, columns = cs, rows = rows }

-- A stored NULL is legal only where the column declares it.
fn cell_ok(v : Json, c : Column) : Bool =
  if is_null(v) then
    c.nullable
  else
    value_type(v) == c.kind

fn validate_column(j : Json) : Column =
  fields(j, ["name", "type", "nullable"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  let t = text(getfield(j, "type"))
  demand(name_ok(n) && elem(t, ["int", "text", "bool"]), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let nullable =
    match getfield(j, "nullable") of
      JBool(b) => b
      _ =>
        reject("INVALID_INPUT")
        false
  Column {
    name = n,
    kind = t,
    nullable = nullable,
    qualifier = "",
    source = 0,
    index = 0
  }

pub fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

pub fn elem(x : a, xs : List(a)) : Bool given Eq(a) =
  match xs of
    Nil => false
    Cons(y, rest) => x == y || elem(x, rest)

-- Live base tables: ordered rows with private identifiers and used-ID sets.
-- A batch is applied to a copy of this state, so a rejected change rolls the
-- whole command back simply by discarding the copy.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Map (..)
import Data.Foldable (length)

pub type TableState = TableState {
  schema: Table,
  rows: Map(Int, List(Json)),
  by_id: Map(Int, Int),
  used: Map(Int, Bool),
  next_pos: Int
}

-- One requested mutation, already checked for shape but not against state.
pub type Change = Change {
  kind: String,
  table: String,
  id: Int,
  cells: List(Json)
}

-- What a committed change did to one base row, in encounter-position terms.
pub type RowDelta = RowDelta {
  table: String,
  pos: Int,
  old: List(Json),
  has_old: Bool,
  cells: List(Json),
  has_new: Bool
}

pub fn initial_table(t : Table) : TableState =
  var rows := map_empty
  var ids := map_empty
  var used := map_empty
  var n := 0
  for r in sof(t.rows) do
    n += 1
    rows := map_insert(n, r, rows)
    ids := map_insert(n, n, ids)
    used := map_insert(n, true, used)
  TableState {
    schema = t,
    rows = rows,
    by_id = ids,
    used = used,
    next_pos = n + 1
  }

-- Update rows are held to the same schema rules as input rows, plus the
-- documented magnitude bound on integers.
fn cell_valid(v : Json, c : Column) : Bool =
  if is_null(v) then
    c.nullable
  else
    value_type(v) == c.kind
      && (c.kind /= "int" || abs(integer(v)) <= 1000000000)

fn check_row(t : TableState, cells : List(Json)) : Unit =
  let cs = t.schema.columns
  demand(length(cells) == length(cs), "INVALID_ROW")
  for i in srange(0, length(cs)) do
    demand(cell_valid(at(cells, i), at(cs, i)), "INVALID_ROW")

pub fn find_state(ts : List(TableState), name : String) : Int =
  find_state_go(ts, name, 0)

fn find_state_go(ts : List(TableState), name : String, i : Int) : Int =
  match ts of
    Nil => -1
    Cons(t, rest) =>
      if t.schema.name == name then
        i
      else
        find_state_go(rest, name, i + 1)

fn row_pos(t : TableState, id : Int) : Int =
  match map_lookup(id, t.by_id) of
    Some(p) => p
    None =>
      reject("UNKNOWN_ROW")
      -1

fn cells_at(t : TableState, p : Int) : List(Json) =
  match map_lookup(p, t.rows) of
    Some(r) => r
    None => []

-- Table existence, then row contents, then identifier state.
fn one_change(ts : List(TableState), c : Change) : (List(TableState), RowDelta) =
  let idx = find_state(ts, c.table)
  demand(idx >= 0, "UNKNOWN_TABLE")
  let t = at(ts, idx)
  if c.kind /= "delete" then
    check_row(t, c.cells)
  if c.kind == "insert" then
    demand(not(map_member(c.id, t.used)), "ROW_ID_USED")
    let p = t.next_pos
    let nt = TableState {
      ..t,
      rows = map_insert(p, c.cells, t.rows),
      by_id = map_insert(c.id, p, t.by_id),
      used = map_insert(c.id, true, t.used),
      next_pos = p + 1
    }
    (
      list_set(ts, idx, nt),
      RowDelta {
        table = c.table,
        pos = p,
        old = [],
        has_old = false,
        cells = c.cells,
        has_new = true
      },
    )
  else
    let p = row_pos(t, c.id)
    let old = cells_at(t, p)
    if c.kind == "update" then
      (
        list_set(ts, idx, TableState { ..t, rows = map_insert(p, c.cells, t.rows) }),
        RowDelta {
          table = c.table,
          pos = p,
          old = old,
          has_old = true,
          cells = c.cells,
          has_new = true
        },
      )
    else
      (
        list_set(
            ts,
            idx,
            TableState {
              ..t,
              rows = map_delete(p, t.rows),
              by_id = map_delete(c.id, t.by_id)
            },
          ),
        RowDelta {
          table = c.table,
          pos = p,
          old = old,
          has_old = true,
          cells = [],
          has_new = false
        },
      )

pub fn apply_changes(
  ts : List(TableState),
  cs : List(Change)
) : (List(TableState), List(RowDelta)) =
  var cur := ts
  var deltas := []
  for c in sof(cs) do
    let (nts, d) = one_change(cur, c)
    cur := nts
    deltas := append(deltas, [d])
  (cur, deltas)

-- Incrementally maintained views.
--
-- A view keeps the intermediate state of its own plan: the filtered scan of
-- every source, the joined prefix after every join, the rows that survived
-- WHERE, and one accumulator set per surviving group. A base-row change enters
-- as a signed delta at the source it touches and is pushed through exactly the
-- operators above that source; nothing else is recomputed, and a view whose
-- tables were untouched does no work at all.
--
-- Every joined row is named by the tuple of encounter positions of the base
-- rows that produced it, encoded as a fixed-width string. Ordering those keys
-- lexicographically reproduces the nested-loop encounter order the contract
-- prescribes, so ties and first-encounter group order survive updates.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Engine (..)
import Store (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Map (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length)

-- An equality conjunct of a join condition, used to index the opposite side.
pub type Equi = Equi { has: Bool, left: Expr, right: Expr }

-- COUNT/SUM keep a running total; MIN/MAX keep the current extreme and fall
-- back to a scan of the group when that extreme is the value being retracted.
pub type Acc = Acc { n: Int, total: Int, extreme: Json }

pub type GroupState = GroupState {
  members: Map(String, List(Json)),
  accs: List(Acc)
}

pub type ViewState = ViewState {
  name: String,
  plan: Plan,
  aggs: List(Expr),
  equis: List(Equi),
  scans: List(Map(Int, List(Json))),
  rindex: List(Map(String, Map(Int, List(Json)))),
  prefix: List(Map(String, List(Json))),
  lindex: List(Map(String, Map(String, List(Json)))),
  matches: List(Map(String, Int)),
  filtered: Map(String, List(Json)),
  groups: Map(String, GroupState)
}

let pad_key : String = "9999999999"

fn key_part(p : Int) : String =
  let s = show_int(p)
  concat(str_repeat("0", max(0, 10 - byte_len(s))), s)

let empty_acc : Acc = Acc { n = 0, total = 0, extreme = JNull }

-- Aggregates are lifted out of SELECT and HAVING before execution: each is
-- replaced by an `aggref` slot that reads the group's maintained accumulator,
-- so projecting a group never walks its rows.
fn lift(e : Expr, acc : List(Expr)) : (Expr, List(Expr)) =
  if agg(e.op) then
    (
      Expr {
        ..node("aggref", []),
        index = length(acc),
        kind = e.kind,
        nullable = e.nullable
      },
      append(acc, [e]),
    )
  else
    let (args, rest) = lift_all(e.args, acc)
    (Expr { ..e, args = args }, rest)

fn lift_all(es : List(Expr), acc : List(Expr)) : (List(Expr), List(Expr)) =
  match es of
    Nil => ([], acc)
    Cons(x, more) =>
      let (x2, acc2) = lift(x, acc)
      let (more2, acc3) = lift_all(more, acc2)
      (Cons(x2, more2), acc3)

fn lift_plan(plan : Plan) : (Plan, List(Expr)) =
  let q = plan.query
  var acc := []
  var sels := []
  for s in sof(q.select) do
    let (e, next) = lift(fst(s), acc)
    acc := next
    sels := append(sels, [(e, snd(s))])
  let (hav, acc2) = lift(q.having, acc)
  (Plan { ..plan, query = Query { ..q, select = sels, having = hav } }, acc2)

fn width_before(plan : Plan, i : Int) : Int =
  var n := 0
  for j in srange(0, i) do
    n += length(at(plan.tables, j).columns)
  n

-- Scan predicates pushed down by the optimizer address global slots, so a
-- lone source row is padded up to its own offset before they are applied.
fn passes(plan : Plan, i : Int, cells : List(Json)) : List(Json) =
  append(replicate(width_before(plan, i), JNull), cells)

fn scan_keeps(plan : Plan, i : Int, cells : List(Json)) : Bool =
  let padded = passes(plan, i, cells)
  all(\(p) -> truth(evaluate(p, padded, [])), at(plan.filters, i))

-- An equality conjunct with one side confined to the sources already joined
-- and the other to the incoming source lets both directions of maintenance
-- look their counterparts up instead of scanning.
fn pick_equi(es : List(Expr), j : Int) : Equi =
  match es of
    Nil => Equi { has = false, left = literal(JNull), right = literal(JNull) }
    Cons(e, rest) =>
      if e.op == "=" then
        let a = at(e.args, 0)
        let b = at(e.args, 1)
        let sa = sources(a)
        let sb = sources(b)
        if (length(sa) > 0
            && length(sb) > 0
            && all(\(s) -> s <= j, sa)
            && all(\(s) -> s == j + 1, sb)) then
          Equi { has = true, left = a, right = b }
        elif (length(sa) > 0
            && length(sb) > 0
            && all(\(s) -> s == j + 1, sa)
            && all(\(s) -> s <= j, sb)) then
          Equi { has = true, left = b, right = a }
        else
          pick_equi(rest, j)
      else
        pick_equi(rest, j)

fn equi_of(plan : Plan, j : Int) : Equi =
  if j + 1 >= length(plan.tables) then
    Equi { has = false, left = literal(JNull), right = literal(JNull) }
  else
    pick_equi(conjuncts(at(plan.query.joins, j)), j)

fn index_key(v : Json) : String = encode(v)

fn match_count(v : ViewState, j : Int, key : String) : Int =
  match map_lookup(key, at(v.matches, j)) of
    Some(n) => n
    None => 0

fn set_match(v : ViewState, j : Int, key : String, n : Int) : ViewState =
  ViewState {
    ..v,
    matches = list_set(v.matches, j, map_insert(key, n, at(v.matches, j)))
  }

fn drop_match(v : ViewState, j : Int, key : String) : ViewState =
  ViewState {
    ..v,
    matches = list_set(v.matches, j, map_delete(key, at(v.matches, j)))
  }

-- Right rows of source j+1 that can satisfy the join with this prefix row.
fn right_candidates(
  v : ViewState,
  j : Int,
  row : List(Json)
) : List((Int, List(Json))) =
  let eq = at(v.equis, j)
  if eq.has then
    let k = evaluate(eq.left, row, [])
    if is_null(k) then
      []
    else
      match map_lookup(index_key(k), at(v.rindex, j + 1)) of
        Some(bucket) => map_to_list(bucket)
        None => []
  else
    map_to_list(at(v.scans, j + 1))

-- Prefix rows at level j that can satisfy the join with this new right row.
fn left_candidates(
  v : ViewState,
  j : Int,
  cells : List(Json)
) : List((String, List(Json))) =
  let eq = at(v.equis, j)
  if eq.has then
    let k = evaluate(eq.right, passes(v.plan, j + 1, cells), [])
    if is_null(k) then
      []
    else
      match map_lookup(index_key(k), at(v.lindex, j)) of
        Some(bucket) => map_to_list(bucket)
        None => []
  else
    map_to_list(at(v.prefix, j))

fn index_right(v : ViewState, i : Int, p : Int, cells : List(Json), add : Bool) : ViewState =
  if i == 0 || not(at(v.equis, i - 1).has) then
    v
  else
    let k = evaluate(at(v.equis, i - 1).right, passes(v.plan, i, cells), [])
    if is_null(k) then
      v
    else
      let key = index_key(k)
      let bucket =
        match map_lookup(key, at(v.rindex, i)) of
          Some(b) => b
          None => map_empty
      let updated = if add then map_insert(p, cells, bucket) else map_delete(p, bucket)
      ViewState {
        ..v,
        rindex = list_set(
            v.rindex,
            i,
            if map_size(updated) == 0 then
              map_delete(key, at(v.rindex, i))
            else
              map_insert(key, updated, at(v.rindex, i)),
          )
      }

fn index_left(
  v : ViewState,
  j : Int,
  key : String,
  row : List(Json),
  add : Bool
) : ViewState =
  if j + 1 >= length(v.plan.tables) || not(at(v.equis, j).has) then
    v
  else
    let k = evaluate(at(v.equis, j).left, row, [])
    if is_null(k) then
      v
    else
      let bk = index_key(k)
      let bucket =
        match map_lookup(bk, at(v.lindex, j)) of
          Some(b) => b
          None => map_empty
      let updated = if add then map_insert(key, row, bucket) else map_delete(key, bucket)
      ViewState {
        ..v,
        lindex = list_set(
            v.lindex,
            j,
            if map_size(updated) == 0 then
              map_delete(bk, at(v.lindex, j))
            else
              map_insert(bk, updated, at(v.lindex, j)),
          )
      }

fn add_scan_row(v : ViewState, i : Int, p : Int, cells : List(Json)) : ViewState =
  index_right(
      ViewState {
        ..v,
        scans = list_set(v.scans, i, map_insert(p, cells, at(v.scans, i)))
      },
      i,
      p,
      cells,
      true,
    )

fn del_scan_row(v : ViewState, i : Int, p : Int, cells : List(Json)) : ViewState =
  index_right(
      ViewState {
        ..v,
        scans = list_set(v.scans, i, map_delete(p, at(v.scans, i)))
      },
      i,
      p,
      cells,
      false,
    )

fn store_prefix(
  v : ViewState,
  j : Int,
  key : String,
  row : List(Json),
  sign : Int
) : ViewState =
  let pm = at(v.prefix, j)
  index_left(
      ViewState {
        ..v,
        prefix = list_set(
            v.prefix,
            j,
            if sign > 0 then map_insert(key, row, pm) else map_delete(key, pm),
          )
      },
      j,
      key,
      row,
      sign > 0,
    )

fn store_filtered(
  v : ViewState,
  key : String,
  row : List(Json),
  sign : Int
) : ViewState =
  ViewState {
    ..v,
    filtered = if sign > 0 then
      map_insert(key, row, v.filtered)
    else
      map_delete(key, v.filtered)
  }

fn null_row(v : ViewState, i : Int) : List(Json) =
  replicate(length(at(v.plan.tables, i).columns), JNull)

-- Apply signed deltas to the joined prefix at level j, then derive the deltas
-- they cause one level up. Padding of an outer join is added or removed here,
-- from the match count kept for the left row.
fn store_all(
  v : ViewState,
  j : Int,
  deltas : List((String, List(Json), Int))
) : ViewState =
  match deltas of
    Nil => v
    Cons(d, rest) =>
      let (key, row, sign) = d
      store_all(store_prefix(v, j, key, row, sign), j, rest)

-- The rows of source j+1 that join with one prefix row, plus the padding an
-- outer join owes a prefix row that found none.
fn expand_one(
  v : ViewState,
  j : Int,
  d : (String, List(Json), Int)
) : (ViewState, List((String, List(Json), Int))) =
  let (key, row, sign) = d
  let outer = at(v.plan.query.outer, j)
  let on = at(v.plan.query.joins, j)
  var child := []
  var found := 0
  for rc in sof(right_candidates(v, j, row)) do
    let joined = append(row, snd(rc))
    if truth(evaluate(on, joined, [])) then
      found += 1
      child := append(child, [(concat(key, key_part(fst(rc))), joined, sign)])
  if outer && found == 0 then
    child := append(
        child,
        [(concat(key, pad_key), append(row, null_row(v, j + 1)), sign)],
      )
  let kept =
    if not(outer) then
      v
    elif sign > 0 then
      set_match(v, j, key, found)
    else
      drop_match(v, j, key)
  (kept, child)

fn expand_all(
  v : ViewState,
  j : Int,
  deltas : List((String, List(Json), Int))
) : (ViewState, List((String, List(Json), Int))) =
  match deltas of
    Nil => (v, [])
    Cons(d, rest) =>
      let (v2, here) = expand_one(v, j, d)
      let (v3, more) = expand_all(v2, j, rest)
      (v3, append(here, more))

-- Apply signed deltas to the joined prefix at level j, then derive the deltas
-- they cause one level up, until the top of the join chain is reached.
fn propagate(
  v : ViewState,
  j : Int,
  deltas : List((String, List(Json), Int))
) : ViewState =
  let cur = store_all(v, j, deltas)
  if j == length(v.plan.tables) - 1 then
    emit(cur, deltas)
  else
    let (st, child) = expand_all(cur, j, deltas)
    propagate(st, j + 1, child)

-- A change to a right-hand source only disturbs the prefix rows it matches.
fn right_delta(
  v : ViewState,
  i : Int,
  p : Int,
  cells : List(Json),
  sign : Int
) : ViewState =
  let outer = at(v.plan.query.outer, i - 1)
  let on = at(v.plan.query.joins, i - 1)
  var st := v
  var child := []
  for lc in sof(left_candidates(v, i - 1, cells)) do
    let (key, row) = lc
    let joined = append(row, cells)
    if truth(evaluate(on, joined, [])) then
      let m = match_count(st, i - 1, key)
      if sign > 0 then
        if outer && m == 0 then
          child := append(
              child,
              [(concat(key, pad_key), append(row, null_row(st, i)), -1)],
            )
        child := append(child, [(concat(key, key_part(p)), joined, 1)])
        if outer then
          st := set_match(st, i - 1, key, m + 1)
      else
        child := append(child, [(concat(key, key_part(p)), joined, -1)])
        if outer && m == 1 then
          child := append(
              child,
              [(concat(key, pad_key), append(row, null_row(st, i)), 1)],
            )
        if outer then
          st := set_match(st, i - 1, key, m - 1)
  propagate(st, i, child)

pub fn insert_scan(v : ViewState, i : Int, p : Int, cells : List(Json)) : ViewState =
  if not(scan_keeps(v.plan, i, cells)) then
    v
  else
    let v2 = add_scan_row(v, i, p, cells)
    if i == 0 then
      propagate(v2, 0, [(key_part(p), cells, 1)])
    else
      right_delta(v2, i, p, cells, 1)

pub fn remove_scan(v : ViewState, i : Int, p : Int, cells : List(Json)) : ViewState =
  if not(scan_keeps(v.plan, i, cells)) then
    v
  else
    let v2 = del_scan_row(v, i, p, cells)
    if i == 0 then
      propagate(v2, 0, [(key_part(p), cells, -1)])
    else
      right_delta(v2, i, p, cells, -1)

-- The top of the pipeline: WHERE, then either the row set of an ordinary view
-- or the accumulators of the group the row belongs to.
fn emit(v : ViewState, deltas : List((String, List(Json), Int))) : ViewState =
  let plan = v.plan
  let keeper = plan.query.predicate
  var cur := v
  for d in sof(deltas) do
    let (key, row, sign) = d
    if truth(evaluate(keeper, row, [])) then
      if plan.aggregate then
        cur := group_delta(cur, key, row, sign)
      else
        cur := store_filtered(cur, key, row, sign)
  cur

fn group_key(v : ViewState, row : List(Json)) : String =
  encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), v.plan.query.groups)))

fn acc_add(a : Acc, e : Expr, row : List(Json)) : Acc =
  if e.op == "COUNT" && length(e.args) == 0 then
    Acc { ..a, n = a.n + 1 }
  else
    let item = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, [])
    if is_null(item) then
      a
    elif e.op == "COUNT" then
      Acc { ..a, n = a.n + 1 }
    elif e.op == "SUM" then
      Acc { n = a.n + 1, total = a.total + integer(item), extreme = JNull }
    else
      let better =
        is_null(a.extreme) || (compare_value(item, a.extreme) < 0) == (e.op == "MIN")
      Acc {
        n = a.n + 1,
        total = 0,
        extreme = if better then item else a.extreme
      }

fn rescan_extreme(
  e : Expr,
  members : Map(String, List(Json))
) : Json =
  var best := JNull
  for row in sof(map_values(members)) do
    let item = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, [])
    if not(is_null(item)) then
      if (is_null(best) || (compare_value(item, best) < 0) == (e.op == "MIN")) then
        best := item
  best

-- `members` has already lost the retracted row, so an extreme that leaves is
-- replaced by rescanning just this group.
fn acc_del(
  a : Acc,
  e : Expr,
  row : List(Json),
  members : Map(String, List(Json))
) : Acc =
  if e.op == "COUNT" && length(e.args) == 0 then
    Acc { ..a, n = a.n - 1 }
  else
    let item = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, [])
    if is_null(item) then
      a
    elif e.op == "COUNT" then
      Acc { ..a, n = a.n - 1 }
    elif e.op == "SUM" then
      Acc { n = a.n - 1, total = a.total - integer(item), extreme = JNull }
    elif compare_value(item, a.extreme) /= 0 then
      Acc { ..a, n = a.n - 1 }
    else
      Acc { n = a.n - 1, total = 0, extreme = rescan_extreme(e, members) }

fn group_delta(v : ViewState, key : String, row : List(Json), sign : Int) : ViewState =
  let gk = group_key(v, row)
  let g =
    match map_lookup(gk, v.groups) of
      Some(x) => x
      None =>
        GroupState { members = map_empty, accs = map(\(_) -> empty_acc, v.aggs) }
  if sign > 0 then
    let updated = GroupState {
      members = map_insert(key, row, g.members),
      accs = map(
          \(i) -> acc_add(at(g.accs, i), at(v.aggs, i), row),
          range(0, length(v.aggs)),
        )
    }
    ViewState { ..v, groups = map_insert(gk, updated, v.groups) }
  else
    let members = map_delete(key, g.members)
    if map_size(members) == 0 then
      ViewState { ..v, groups = map_delete(gk, v.groups) }
    else
      let updated = GroupState {
        members = members,
        accs = map(
            \(i) -> acc_del(at(g.accs, i), at(v.aggs, i), row, members),
            range(0, length(v.aggs)),
          )
      }
      ViewState { ..v, groups = map_insert(gk, updated, v.groups) }

-- Creation runs the query once: the later sources are loaded directly and the
-- rows of the first are streamed through the join, which is the nested-loop
-- evaluation the one-shot engine would have performed.
pub fn create_view(
  name : String,
  plan0 : Plan,
  tables : List(TableState)
) : ViewState =
  let (plan, aggs) = lift_plan(plan0)
  let n = length(plan.tables)
  var v := ViewState {
    name = name,
    plan = plan,
    aggs = aggs,
    equis = map(\(j) -> equi_of(plan, j), range(0, n)),
    scans = map(\(_) -> map_empty, range(0, n)),
    rindex = map(\(_) -> map_empty, range(0, n)),
    prefix = map(\(_) -> map_empty, range(0, n)),
    lindex = map(\(_) -> map_empty, range(0, n)),
    matches = map(\(_) -> map_empty, range(0, n)),
    filtered = map_empty,
    groups = map_empty
  }
  for i in srange(1, n) do
    let st = at(tables, find_state(tables, at(plan.tables, i).name))
    for kv in sof(map_to_list(st.rows)) do
      if scan_keeps(plan, i, snd(kv)) then
        v := add_scan_row(v, i, fst(kv), snd(kv))
  let first = at(tables, find_state(tables, at(plan.tables, 0).name))
  for kv in sof(map_to_list(first.rows)) do
    v := insert_scan(v, 0, fst(kv), snd(kv))
  v

-- Only the sources that name a changed table are disturbed; a view over other
-- tables leaves this loop untouched.
pub fn apply_deltas(v : ViewState, ds : List(RowDelta)) : ViewState =
  var cur := v
  for d in sof(ds) do
    for i in srange(0, length(v.plan.tables)) do
      if at(v.plan.tables, i).name == d.table then
        if d.has_old then
          cur := remove_scan(cur, i, d.pos, d.old)
        if d.has_new then
          cur := insert_scan(cur, i, d.pos, d.cells)
  cur

fn agg_value(e : Expr, a : Acc) : Json =
  if e.op == "COUNT" then
    JInt(a.n)
  elif a.n == 0 then
    JNull
  elif e.op == "SUM" then
    JInt(a.total)
  else
    a.extreme

fn project_group(v : ViewState, g : GroupState) : List(List(Json)) =
  let vals = map(
      \(i) -> agg_value(at(v.aggs, i), at(g.accs, i)),
      range(0, length(v.aggs)),
    )
  let rep =
    match map_min(g.members) of
      Some(kv) => snd(kv)
      None => []
  if truth(evaluate(v.plan.query.having, rep, [vals])) then
    [map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), rep, [vals]), v.plan.query.select)]
  else
    []

fn first_key(g : GroupState) : String =
  match map_min(g.members) of
    Some(kv) => fst(kv)
    None => ""

-- Groups appear in order of first encounter, which is the smallest row key
-- still in the group.
fn ordered_groups(v : ViewState) : List(GroupState) =
  let keyed = map(\(kv) -> (first_key(snd(kv)), fst(kv)), map_to_list(v.groups))
  map(\(pair) -> group_named(v, snd(pair)), sort(keyed))

fn group_named(v : ViewState, gk : String) : GroupState =
  match map_lookup(gk, v.groups) of
    Some(g) => g
    None => GroupState { members = map_empty, accs = [] }

pub fn read_view(v : ViewState) : Json =
  let q = v.plan.query
  let projected =
    if v.plan.aggregate then
      let gs = ordered_groups(v)
      if length(gs) == 0 && length(q.groups) == 0 then
        project_group(
            v,
            GroupState { members = map_empty, accs = map(\(_) -> empty_acc, v.aggs) },
          )
      else
        flatten(map(\(g) -> project_group(v, g), gs))
    else
      map(
          \(row) -> map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, []), q.select),
          map_values(v.filtered),
        )
  finalize(v.plan, projected)

fn check(e : Expr, columns : List(Column), allow : Bool, inside : Bool) : Expr =
  if e.op == "col" then
    let matches = filter(
        \(c) -> c.name == e.name && (e.qualifier == "" || e.qualifier == c.qualifier),
        columns,
      )
    demand(length(matches) > 0, "UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
    demand(length(matches) == 1, "AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN")
    let c = at(matches, 0)
    Expr {
      ..e,
      index = c.index,
      source = c.source,
      kind = c.kind,
      nullable = c.nullable
    }
  elif e.op == "lit" then
    e
  else
    let isagg = agg(e.op)
    demand(not(isagg) || allow && not(inside), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    let args = map(\(a) -> check(a, columns, allow, inside || isagg), e.args)
    let ts = map(\(a) -> a.kind, args)
    let kind =
      if e.op == "COUNT" then
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["SUM", "+", "-", "*"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> compatible(t, "int"), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["MIN", "MAX"]) then
        demand(elem(at(ts, 0), ["int", "text", "null"]), "TYPE_ERROR")
        at(ts, 0)
      elif elem(e.op, ["NOT", "AND", "OR"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> compatible(t, "bool"), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "bool"
      elif elem(e.op, ["ISNULL", "ISNOTNULL"]) then
        "bool"
      elif e.op == "COALESCE" then
        let known = filter(\(t) -> t /= "null", ts)
        if length(known) == 0 then
          "null"
        else
          demand(all(\(t) -> t == at(known, 0), known), "TYPE_ERROR")
          at(known, 0)
      else
        demand(
            compatible(at(ts, 0), at(ts, 1))
              && (not(elem("bool", ts)) || elem(e.op, ["=", "<>"])),
            "TYPE_ERROR",
          )
        "bool"
    Expr { ..e, args = args, kind = kind, nullable = nullability(e.op, args) }

defs.name: evaluate
defs.source:
fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif op == "aggref" then
    at(at(group, 0), e.index)
  elif op == "COUNT" then
    if length(e.args) == 0 then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      JInt(length(filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), column_of(e, group))))
  elif agg(op) then
    let vs = filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), column_of(e, group))
    if length(vs) == 0 then
      JNull
    elif op == "SUM" then
      JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
    else
      extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    first_present(e.args, row, group)
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "ISNULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "ISNOTNULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then
        JNull
      else
        JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then
          JBool(false)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(true)
      elif op == "OR" then
        if truth(a) || truth(b) then
          JBool(true)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(false)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn simplify(n : Expr) : Expr =
  if length(n.args) == 1 then
    let a = at(n.args, 0)
    if elem(n.op, ["ISNULL", "ISNOTNULL"]) && not(a.nullable) then
      constant(n.op == "ISNOTNULL")
    else
      n
  elif length(n.args) == 2 then
    let a = at(n.args, 0)
    let b = at(n.args, 1)
    if same_column(a, b) && not(a.nullable) then
      if elem(n.op, ["=", "<=", ">="]) then
        constant(true)
      elif elem(n.op, ["<>", "<", ">"]) then
        constant(false)
      else
        n
    elif (elem(n.op, ["AND", "OR"])
        && complementary(a, b)
        && not(a.nullable)
        && not(b.nullable)) then
      constant(n.op == "OR")
    else
      n
  else
    n

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc, nulls_first), rest) =>
      let x = at(a, i)
      let y = at(b, i)
      if is_null(x) && is_null(y) then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif is_null(x) then
        if nulls_first then
          -1
        else
          1
      elif is_null(y) then
        if nulls_first then
          1
        else
          -1
      else
        let c = compare_value(x, y)
        if c == 0 then
          row_compare(a, b, rest)
        elif desc then
          -c
        else
          c

  a : List(List(Json)),
  b : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match (a, b) of
    (Nil, _) => b
    (_, Nil) => a
    (Cons(x, xs), Cons(y, ys)) =>
      if row_compare(x, y, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(x, merge_rows(xs, b, order))
      else
        Cons(y, merge_rows(a, ys, order))

  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  let n = length(rows)
  if n <= 1 then
    rows
  else
    let half = n / 2
    merge_rows(
        sort_rows(take(half, rows), order),
        sort_rows(drop(half, rows), order),
        order,
      )

fn finalize(plan : Plan, projected : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  let distinct =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_rows(projected, map_empty)
    else
      projected
  let sorted =
    if length(plan.order) > 0 then
      sort_rows(distinct, plan.order)
    else
      distinct
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, sorted)
  let final =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      take(q.limit, skipped)
    else
      skipped
  JObj([
      ("columns", JArr(map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), q.select))),
      ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, final))),
    ])

fn lex(s : String, i : Int) : List(Token) =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    [tok("$END")]
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if elem(c, [32, 9, 10, 13]) then
      lex(s, i + 1)
    elif c == 39 then
      let (v, j) = scan_string(s, i + 1, "")
      Cons(Token { word = "LITERAL", value = JStr(v) }, lex(s, j))
    elif digit(c) then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, true)
      let n =
        match parse_int(slice(s, i, j)) of
          Some(v) => v
          None => 0
      Cons(Token { word = "NUMBER", value = JInt(n) }, lex(s, j))
    elif letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90 then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, false)
      let w = slice(s, i, j)
      Cons(tok(if reserved(w) then to_upper(w) else w), lex(s, j))
    else
      let two = slice(s, i, min(i + 2, byte_len(s)))
      if elem(two, ["<>", "<=", ">="]) then
        Cons(tok(two), lex(s, i + 2))
      else
        demand(
            elem(c, [40, 41, 44, 46, 59, 43, 45, 42, 61, 60, 62]),
            "PARSE_ERROR",
          )
        Cons(tok(str_of_char(chr(c))), lex(s, i + 1))

fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node(w, [expression(3)])
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif w == "NULL" then
      literal(JNull)
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif w == "COALESCE" then
      expect("(")
      let args = arguments()
      expect(")")
      demand(length(args) >= 2, "PARSE_ERROR")
      node(w, args)
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

    if accept("ORDER") then
      expect("BY")
      order_keys()
    else
      []
  let lim =
    if accept("LIMIT") then
      natural()
    else
      -1
  let off =
    if lim >= 0 && accept("OFFSET") then
      natural()
    else
      0
  let ignored = accept(";")
  demand(peek() == "$END", "PARSE_ERROR")
  Query {
    select = sels,
    sources = ss,
    joins = js,
    outer = os,
    predicate = pred,
    groups = groups,
    having = hav,
    has_having = hh,
    order = order,
    distinct = distinct,
    limit = lim,
    offset = off
  }

  key : String,
  row : List(Json),

) : ViewState =
  if j + 1 >= length(v.plan.tables) || not(at(v.equis, j).has) then
    v
  else
    let k = evaluate(at(v.equis, j).left, row, [])
    if is_null(k) then

      let bucket =

      ViewState {
        ..v,
        lindex = list_set(
            v.lindex,
            j,
            if map_size(updated) == 0 then

fn expand_one(
  v : ViewState,
  j : Int,
  d : (String, List(Json), Int)
) : (ViewState, List((String, List(Json), Int))) =
  let (key, row, sign) = d
  let outer = at(v.plan.query.outer, j)
  let on = at(v.plan.query.joins, j)
  var child := []
  var found := 0
  for rc in sof(right_candidates(v, j, row)) do
    let joined = append(row, snd(rc))
    if truth(evaluate(on, joined, [])) then
      found += 1
      child := append(child, [(concat(key, key_part(fst(rc))), joined, sign)])
  if outer && found == 0 then
    child := append(
        child,
        [(concat(key, pad_key), append(row, null_row(v, j + 1)), sign)],
      )
  let kept =
    if not(outer) then
      v
    elif sign > 0 then
      set_match(v, j, key, found)
    else
      drop_match(v, j, key)
  (kept, child)

fn right_delta(
  v : ViewState,
  i : Int,
  p : Int,
  cells : List(Json),
  sign : Int
) : ViewState =
  let outer = at(v.plan.query.outer, i - 1)
  let on = at(v.plan.query.joins, i - 1)
  var st := v
  var child := []
  for lc in sof(left_candidates(v, i - 1, cells)) do
    let (key, row) = lc
    let joined = append(row, cells)
    if truth(evaluate(on, joined, [])) then
      let m = match_count(st, i - 1, key)
      if sign > 0 then
        if outer && m == 0 then
          child := append(
              child,
              [(concat(key, pad_key), append(row, null_row(st, i)), -1)],
            )
        child := append(child, [(concat(key, key_part(p)), joined, 1)])
        if outer then
          st := set_match(st, i - 1, key, m + 1)
      else
        child := append(child, [(concat(key, key_part(p)), joined, -1)])
        if outer && m == 1 then
          child := append(
              child,
              [(concat(key, pad_key), append(row, null_row(st, i)), 1)],
            )
        if outer then
          st := set_match(st, i - 1, key, m - 1)
  propagate(st, i, child)

fn create_view(
  name : String,
  plan0 : Plan,
  tables : List(TableState)
) : ViewState =
  let (plan, aggs) = lift_plan(plan0)
  let n = length(plan.tables)
  var v := ViewState {
    name = name,
    plan = plan,
    aggs = aggs,
    equis = map(\(j) -> equi_of(plan, j), range(0, n)),
    scans = map(\(_) -> map_empty, range(0, n)),
    rindex = map(\(_) -> map_empty, range(0, n)),
    prefix = map(\(_) -> map_empty, range(0, n)),
    lindex = map(\(_) -> map_empty, range(0, n)),
    matches = map(\(_) -> map_empty, range(0, n)),
    filtered = map_empty,
    groups = map_empty
  }
  for i in srange(1, n) do
    let st = at(tables, find_state(tables, at(plan.tables, i).name))
    for kv in sof(map_to_list(st.rows)) do
      if scan_keeps(plan, i, snd(kv)) then
        v := add_scan_row(v, i, fst(kv), snd(kv))
  let first = at(tables, find_state(tables, at(plan.tables, 0).name))
  for kv in sof(map_to_list(first.rows)) do
